lines.text: {winner} can finally stop defending the ambition and enjoy having achieved it.
Down here, you would understand forgetting the prepared remarks. Winning can do that to a sensible speech.
lines.was: Down here, you would understand a long pause before finding anything useful to say.

lines.text: For {loser}, the contest ends with respect due and disappointment to absorb.
At {winnerClub}, the whole journey now has the ending they hoped to give it.
You can imagine {winner} looking again, simply because the answer is worth another look.
Pressure has somewhere to go at last. For the successful rival, it can no longer spoil the pleasure.
lines.was: The pressure has somewhere to go at last. There is nothing left hanging over this contest.

lines.text: {loserClub} leaves a rivalry behind that deserves more than a glance at the closing result.
All that anticipation is now a memory with a name attached, and it is not going to be forgotten.
lines.was: All that anticipation has become a memory somebody will be very reluctant to put away.

lines.text: From {winner}'s position, even the ordinary business of sitting still must feel different now.
Nothing further is required. You could understand a lingering suspicion that surely there must be another task.
lines.was: Nothing further is required. That can take a moment to sink in after so much expectation.

lines.text: With {winnerClub} taking the Showdown, the hard work has acquired a lasting shape.
A rivalry ends, and the work stops disguising itself as worry. There is an achievement to admire.
lines.was: A rivalry ends, and suddenly there is room to appreciate what it demanded.

lines.text: Ask {loser} for a response too quickly and you may miss the weight of the occasion.
Relief carries a surprise of its own, discovering how deeply you wanted the outcome that finally arrived.
lines.was: There is a particular relief in finding that the hoped-for answer is also the final answer.

lines.text: Here is {winner}, with the long argument settled and the pleasure still arriving.
The quiet afterward can hold more satisfaction than anything said while the outcome was open.
Perhaps {winnerClub} will need a moment to stop thinking about what comes next.
Some achievements arrive loudly. Others need a second look before their size becomes clear.
Over at {loserClub}, appreciation may take longer than acceptance. That is entirely understandable.
Think of the original hope. It has grown into something sturdy enough to keep.
lines.was: Think of the ambition at the start. It has somewhere permanent to live now.

lines.text: If {winner} looks back from here, the uncertainty will have a very different color.
Getting to the end with the prize is a lovely way to discover how tired you are.
{winnerClub} can turn the page at leisure. Nobody is waiting to rewrite this conclusion.
Even a friendly contest can leave a substantial silence when the question is finally answered.
Take the view from {loserClub}, a painful result need not diminish the value of having competed.
All the unfinished sentences can be completed for {winner} now. The Showdown belongs to them.
No nervous checking required anymore, although old habits might take a while to hear the news.
{loser} faces the delicate business of rivalry, meaning the congratulations while wishing they were coming back.
lines.was: {loser} has reached the difficult part of a good rivalry, congratulating the friend who beat you.

lines.text: Celebration is a pleasant change of occupation after spending so long wondering about the outcome.
The question for {winnerClub} is how to sound modest without making the congratulations seem unnecessary.
lines.was: The awkward question for {winnerClub} is how to sound modest without wasting a thoroughly earned moment.

lines.text: Somewhere between a laugh and a deep breath, the scale of this success ought to reveal itself.
lines.was: Somewhere, a relieved sigh could be doing more expressive work than a prepared speech.

lines.text: Give {winner} time to enjoy this before asking for a sensible explanation of the feeling.
Give {winner} room to enjoy this before requesting the sensible version for the post-season interview.
lines.was: Winning the whole thing ought to come with permission to leave the washing up until later.

lines.text: As {loserClub} takes stock, the rival's happiness may be rather easier to understand than to share.
Taking stock at {loserClub}, the rival's happiness is easier to understand than to join in with.
lines.was: Nobody needs to rehearse an argument about how it might turn out. That department has closed.

lines.text: Finally {winnerClub} can admire the destination without also checking the route.
Good friends congratulate each other. Very good friends allow a little time to get the expression right.
To {winner}, a suggestion, remember the feeling before the success becomes a story you tell on autopilot.
lines.was: To {winner}, a useful suggestion, remember this feeling before the story becomes something you tell too easily.

lines.text: Finishing successfully is strange. Your biggest preoccupation suddenly hands in its notice.
lines.was: Finishing successfully is strange. The thing that occupied your thoughts suddenly offers to leave you alone.

lines.text: After all the anticipation, {loser} can take pride in having made this worth winning.
A little restraint is admirable. Requiring complete modesty at a moment like this seems ambitious.
There will be no need for {winnerClub} to add a hopeful qualification to the news.
Nothing for {winnerClub} to qualify hopefully anymore. The result no longer needs a wish attached.
lines.was: The most satisfying explanation may be the shortest, it is done, and it is yours.

lines.text: Success makes a lovely change from suspense, especially when your friend has to acknowledge the difference.
lines.was: Put yourself beside {winner}, trying to describe a feeling that keeps getting in the way of the description.

lines.text: Tomorrow's version of this story will probably sound calmer than the experience of living it.
Even {loserClub} can recognize what the successful rival has earned, however slowly the congratulations arrive.
Respect from {loserClub} belongs beside the achievement. Immediate enthusiasm might be too much to ask.
lines.was: Relief tends to get overlooked in advance. At the end, it can take up most of the room.

lines.text: For {winnerClub}, the answer to that constant what-if has become a very agreeable fact.
Friendly competition produces the odd situation where somebody you like becomes delightfully hard to tolerate.
Leave {winner} with the happy problem of deciding how often this can reasonably come up in conversation.
{winner} might discover that accepting compliments is easier once there is nothing left to defend.
Success has canceled the appointment with worry. Leaving that space empty sounds like a sensible celebration.
lines.was: Success has canceled an appointment with worry. It would be rude not to enjoy the free time.

lines.text: Near {loserClub}'s dugout, you would understand a preference for discussing almost anything else.
Keeping the last word is lovely. Working out when to stop repeating it requires a different skill.
lines.was: Having the last word is lovely. Finding a tasteful way to repeat it is the delicate part.

lines.text: That is {winnerClub}'s privilege now, remembering the nerves with the reassurance of knowing how they ended.
lines.was: That is {winnerClub}'s prize now, knowing the memory will survive the excitement that made it.

lines.text: Modesty can make an appearance later. Nobody sensible would put it in charge of proceedings immediately.
Should {winner} need reassurance, a completed Showdown is more persuasive than another encouraging pep talk.
lines.was: Should {winner} need reassurance, the completed Showdown makes a fairly convincing character reference.

lines.text: Imagine putting all that tension down and discovering you were carrying more than you realized.
A difficult goodbye for {loser}, who helped make this more than an achievement in isolation.
lines.was: A difficult goodbye to the contest for {loser}, but a worthy rivalry all the same.

lines.text: The best kind of tiredness is the kind that comes without a disappointed explanation attached.
{winnerClub} has retired the word nearly from this particular ambition.
A polished speech may have been prepared. Winning the whole thing is a good excuse to lose your place.
lines.was: There may be a perfectly sensible speech available. A happy silence could do the job just as well.

lines.text: Whether {winner} admits to dreaming about this or not, there is no need to imagine it anymore.
Pleasure sometimes arrives dressed as disbelief. Give it room to take its coat off.
lines.was: Pleasure sometimes arrives dressed as disbelief. Give it a moment to take its coat off.

lines.text: Respect for {loserClub} belongs in the picture too. A rivalry needs somebody worth overcoming.
Settling the argument is satisfying. Leaving it with a friend still worth arguing with is better.
lines.was: Finishing an argument is satisfying. Finishing it with your friend still beside you is better.

lines.text: Look at the prospect for {winnerClub}, the luxury of remembering without first having to worry.
At last, the goal can stop demanding attention and start rewarding the effort it received.
lines.was: At last, ambition can change out of its working clothes and sit with what it achieved.

lines.text: Around {loser}, you would forgive a generous congratulations delivered with a fairly measured smile.
Certainty has arrived, and it turns out to be far easier company than the suspense that preceded it.
lines.was: Certainty has finally arrived, and it has brought considerably better company than suspense.

lines.text: Behind {winner}'s success lies an experience that no tidy explanation can quite compress.
Explanations can wait their turn. A successful ending deserves the right to interrupt.
lines.was: Explanations can wait their turn. The pleasure of having done it deserves the first invitation.

lines.text: Unlike the preparation, {winnerClub}'s enjoyment no longer comes with a warning about the work remaining.
The tension never promised to leave politely. Success has at least given it a reason to go.
When {winner} looks back, this will be the place where all the hoping found its answer.
This Showdown is {winner}'s, and every unfinished thought about it can finally come to rest.
lines.was: The Showdown is {winner}'s, and every unfinished thought about it can finally come to rest.

lines.text: Listen to what is missing now, the need to prove that the belief was justified.
Beneath the disappointment for {loser}, there is a contest that made the victory worth earning.
An ending can fit inside a sentence while taking up an enormous place in somebody's life.
lines.was: An ending can be simple to describe and enormous to live through.

lines.text: {winnerClub} has reached the far side of uncertainty, with the prize safely attached to its name.
Ordinary words can seem very small when they have to carry an experience of this size.
Language can look very small beside the experience of completing something you cared about deeply.
lines.was: A moment for {winner} to keep, long after the urgency that created it has faded.

lines.text: Distance from the occasion may bring perspective. It will not make the achievement any less personal.
Whatever {loserClub} hoped this would become, the response to defeat can still honor the friendship.
Quietly or loudly, relief will find its way into the space the pressure leaves behind.
Loudly or quietly, relief will find its way into the space the pressure leaves behind.
lines.was: {winner} no longer has to picture being here. That imagined moment has become a lived memory.

lines.text: Beyond the contest lies the pleasure of telling the story without needing to change its ending.
Beyond the outcome lies a lasting privilege, telling the story without having to improve its conclusion.
lines.was: Through {winnerClub}'s eyes, the whole journey can now be seen from the place it was meant to reach.

lines.text: Through {winnerClub}'s eyes, the journey can be admired without searching it for a different turn.
lines.was: Hard to explain in advance, the size of the silence once a consuming ambition is fulfilled.

lines.text: Hard to anticipate, the sense of space when a demanding hope stops asking questions and becomes an achievement.
lines.was: From {loser}'s side, accepting the answer does not erase the courage it took to seek another.

lines.text: From {loser}'s side, acceptance need not erase the pride in challenging a friend for something that mattered.
lines.was: Everything that once felt provisional now belongs to a story with its conclusion intact.

lines.text: {winnerClub} can close this chapter knowing the signature at the bottom will stay there.
Pride takes its time sometimes, arriving after the immediate relief has found somewhere to settle.
Inside {winner}'s memory, this ending will give the difficult parts a warmer place to live.
Suddenly, the pressure belongs to yesterday. Today is allowed to be about what it produced.
Hold the feeling before familiarity softens it. Fulfilled hopes deserve more than a hurried glance.
lines.was: As {loserClub} leaves the contest, respect is still available, even where satisfaction is not.

lines.text: Hold the moment before it becomes familiar. Fulfilled hopes deserve more than a hurried glance.
Ask {winner} what it means, and leave room for the experience to grow into words.
lines.was: Ask {winner} what it means, and allow a little room for the answer to catch up.

lines.text: Closure does not always arrive with a speech. Sometimes it is simply the freedom to breathe properly.
Nothing left to chase in this Showdown, {winnerClub}. The ambition has come home.
